name: swatch-words
title: Swatch Words
description: Colour names rendered in their own colour with a click-to-copy chip: the word is the swatch, a miniature circular chip rides the baseline, and clicking copies the hex with a small toast — a palette you can read.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Playful
Macrostructure: Rail
Density: Airy
Shape: Rounded
Motion: None
Typography: Grotesk
Color: Pastel

## Rules

- Click Copy: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
